status: written before any fixbc arm ran
observation_motivating_it: A1 shows wide arms below the default: wide:role.expand_conv -8.3 pp (INT6) and -10.2 pp (FP6 E2M3), wide:position.late -5.9 pp (INT6), wide:role.se_pool -2.5 pp (FP6). Every v1 arm refits the sequential bias correction for its own plan; the question is whether that refit causes the losses.

diagnostic_arms.fixbc_definition: NAME+fixbc = the wide/only/reference arm NAME with the conv/linear biases of the default arm (bias correction fitted once for the frozen default plan, same calibration images) instead of a refit. Diagnostic only, never a recipe. Code: tools/experiment_b2_attrib/lmrunner.py build_fixbc.
diagnostic_arms.control: ref_default+fixbc must reproduce the ref_default logits sha256 (same biases, same plan)
diagnostic_arms.reading: if wide:G+fixbc recovers where wide:G loses, the per-arm refit is the cause and the attribution is reported in both readings; the recipe is not changed (lane Q3 owns bias-correction failures)

r3_repairs: the up-to-3 attribution-driven repair arms reserved by addendum 2 are not defined here; a later addendum defines them before they run
gpu: low-memory path; 21 arms, about 8 GPU-minutes; within the unchanged 10800 s cap
